scope: Independent Python recomputation from existing JSON/TSV/collapsed plus analyzer source audit; no Java, no new capture, no second JFR decoder. JFR and small source/artifact hashes checked; full graph/JAR posthash assertions trusted from capture receipt and its inspected script, not rehashed here.

sourceAudit.outerBinding: ProfileWindows.queryTrace enforces exact execute signature and broad-query-pressure-worker. 34 nonoverlapping windows bound ordinally to exact catalog IDs; JFR contains no query ID.
sourceAudit.phaseBinding: DistinctPhaseWindows.phase matches QueryPipeline owner plus initial/provenance generated method names, not descriptor or graph ID. Current captured calls checked 192 per recording and only expected 3 queries; generic analyzer itself requires >0, not 192.
sourceAudit.partition: Union of all-thread call intervals for each phase, half-open [start,end). No initial/provenance union overlap; other is complement. Samples from all threads assigned by timestamp once, never summed call wall duration.
sourceAudit.background: Thread groups are mutually exclusive identities, not phase causal attribution; compiler detected by name or CompileBroker::compiler_thread_loop root. GC/JIT co-occurrence cannot be assigned to the query phase.
sourceAudit.stacks: Metric.add uses a HashSet of frame names per event to avoid recursive inclusive double charge; frames from separate methods still overlap. Top lists are truncated summaries and cannot generally be summed for conservation; full collapsed used for outer weights.
limits: Phase JSON lacks internal method descriptors; bytecode/JFR phase signature not independently re-decoded.
Missing event traces with no samples can evade a >0/count-only generalized check; current expected call census and source control flow agree but not graph identity proof.
Zero missing/truncated sampled stacks does not prove every allocation/function call was sampled; 256KiB TLAB weights are not exact whole allocation bytes or allocation CPU savings.
Large positive TSV gap is untraced wall and is explicitly retained; only negative gap beyond 1ms is rejected.
Temporal phase union includes waiting/gaps inside calls; not exclusive engine CPU or exact end-to-end acceptance latency.
Historical ideal-zero-dense calculation fixes all other measured rows and is a conditional sensitivity analysis, not a causal prediction or new acceptance result.
